title: The School Clean-Up Day
taskText: The school is organising a clean-up day. Write an email to your friend Mei Ling to tell her about the event and suggest one way she can help.

taskChunks.text: Tell your friend about the school clean-up day.
Your friend Mei Ling is the person you are writing to.
The school is organising a clean-up day for pupils to help keep the school clean.

keyInfo: The clean-up day will be held on Saturday, 18 October.
Pupils should meet at the school hall at 8.30 a.m.
Pupils should wear comfortable clothes and covered shoes.
The school will provide gloves and rubbish bags.
The activity will end at 11.30 a.m.
distractorStimulusPoints: The school canteen will sell pizzas at 8.00 a.m.
The school football team has a match on Sunday.
ownContentPrompt: Suggest one practical way Mei Ling can help with the clean-up day.
ownContentIdeas: help sort the rubbish into recycling bins
make a poster reminding classmates to come
modelLetter:
Hi Mei Ling,

How are you? I hope you have been well.

I am writing to tell you about our school clean-up day. Our school is organising this event so that pupils can help keep the school clean.

The clean-up day will be held on Saturday, 18 October. We should meet at the school hall at 8.30 a.m. We should wear comfortable clothes and covered shoes. The school will provide gloves and rubbish bags. The activity will end at 11.30 a.m.

You could bring extra reusable bags to help collect rubbish.

Hope you can join us!

Best regards,
Alicia
